_ordering_rationale: F5 (FFIV) = applications networking (load balancing BIG-IP + sécurité applicative). Split revenue Systems (hardware) vs Software (subscription/SaaS/perpetual) vs Services (maintenance). Order = pilotes business modernes (Software, Subscription) puis legacy (Systems).

kpis_supplementary.signal: Pivot software récurrent : +9% FY25, transformation business model en cours, plus haute marge.
kpis_supplementary.description_fr: Revenus software F5 (subscription + SaaS/managed services + perpetual licenses). Pivot stratégique depuis hardware BIG-IP vers software/SaaS. Marge supérieure, récurrence accrue.
kpis_supplementary.description_en: F5 software revenue (subscription + SaaS/managed services + perpetual licenses). Strategic pivot from BIG-IP hardware to software/SaaS. Higher margin, increased recurring.

kpis_supplementary.signal: Hypercroissance +18% FY25 : moteur principal du pivot recurring, qualité revenue maximale.
kpis_supplementary.description_fr: Sous-segment Subscription des Software revenues, le plus stratégique. Term-based licenses prepaid, base recurring solide. +18% FY25 vs +22% FY24.
kpis_supplementary.description_en: Subscription sub-segment of Software revenue, most strategic. Prepaid term-based licenses, solid recurring base. +18% FY25 vs +22% FY24.

kpis_supplementary.signal: Décroissance -9% FY25, contraste avec Subscription. Repositionnement portfolio SaaS en cours.
kpis_supplementary.description_fr: Revenues SaaS hébergés (Distributed Cloud, Volterra) + managed services. En baisse vs subscription term licenses qui captent la croissance. Mix produit en évolution.
kpis_supplementary.description_en: Hosted SaaS (Distributed Cloud, Volterra) + managed services revenue. Declining vs subscription term licenses capturing growth. Product mix evolving.

kpis_supplementary.signal: Rebond hardware +31% FY25 après creux FY24 : cycle refresh BIG-IP + AI workloads networking.
kpis_supplementary.description_fr: Revenus hardware BIG-IP (appliances load balancing & sécurité). Cyclique. Rebond marqué FY25 lié au refresh BIG-IP iSeries et nouveaux workloads AI nécessitant networking applicatif.
kpis_supplementary.description_en: BIG-IP hardware revenue (load balancing & security appliances). Cyclical. Strong FY25 rebound from BIG-IP iSeries refresh and AI workloads requiring application networking.

kpis_supplementary.signal: Services maintenance >51% du CA total : annuity recurring base massive, croissance stable.
kpis_supplementary.description_fr: Revenues services (maintenance hardware/software, support technique, consulting). >51% du CA total, base annuity ultra-stable. Marge brute services ~85%.
kpis_supplementary.description_en: Services revenue (hardware/software maintenance, technical support, consulting). >51% of total revenue, ultra-stable annuity base. Services gross margin ~85%.

kpis_supplementary.signal: Acceleration FY25 +9.7% vs +0.1% FY24 : reprise hardware + traction software subscription.
kpis_supplementary.description_fr: Chiffre d'affaires consolidé. Stagnation FY24 (2,816 vs 2,813) puis forte reprise FY25 portée par Systems et Subscription.
kpis_supplementary.description_en: Consolidated revenue. FY24 stagnation (2,816 vs 2,813) then strong FY25 rebound driven by Systems and Subscription.

_extraction_method: 10-K filings cat1-us 2021-2025, tables segmentaires Net Revenue + Total Net Product Revenue extraites. Aucune valeur inventee.
